That points toward training-time directions such as schema augmentation, parameter-renaming robustness, or partially decoupling tool semantics from raw textual interfaces.ba:T5de,The method has two main pieces. First is a retrieval-based labeling pipeline. Starting from a corpus of user sessions, the system uses an off-the-shelf memory extractor (mem0 in the paper) to produce atomic candidate facts from each session. Under an infinite-budget construction, all extracted facts are added to a growing candidate memory pool. For each candidate fact, the pipeline scans future user turns. A turn is first judged on whether memory is needed; if memory is queried, retrieval is performed. A fact is labeled useful if it is retrieved in a later interaction and its content is actually incorporated into the model’s answer. An LLM judge is used to verify that the retrieved fact was genuinely used, reducing noise from superficial retrieval hits.

Second is Warm-Start UCB. The offline stage learns a shared utility pattern from historical users, providing a prior or initialization. The online stage adapts to a new user with an upper-confidence-bound algorithm under one-sided delayed feedback. Because feedback is observed only for admitted facts and only after an unknown delay, the problem is cast as an apple-tasting style decision process. UCB handles the exploration–exploitation trade-off by favoring facts with both high predicted value and high uncertainty. Compared with pure offline supervision, this explicitly models partial and delayed feedback. Compared with a cold-start contextual bandit, warm start uses population data to avoid learning each user from scratch.bb:T4ba,From the provided full-text excerpt, the evaluation is built on PerMemBench-S and an additional longer-horizon synthetic benchmark, PerMemBench-L. The main empirical claim is that Warm-Start UCB consistently outperforms both, suggesting that online personalization matters and that the retrieval-derived labels are useful for learning.

The most informative parts are likely not just the aggregate score tables but three supporting analyses. First, label-validity checks in the appendix test whether retrieval-based labels really correspond to future usefulness. Second, the paper analyzes which utility patterns are shared across users and which are user-specific; that directly motivates the two-stage design. Third, the theory argues that warm start helps leverage offline data while the online UCB component moves toward user-specific behavior. The excerpt you provided does not include the full result tables or trustworthy numeric deltas, so I should not invent exact gains or sample sizes; those need to be read from the main tables and appendices.bc:T603,SPLIT models success as:
P(success) = P(at least one correct candidate exists) × P(it is selected | it exists),
and explicitly models the second term (selection), not just coverage.

Section 3 derives exact success formulas for two selectors widely used:
1) Uniform selection among verifier-accepted candidates.
2) Argmax selection by verifier score.

The formulas incorporate verifier true/false accept rates and three correlation sources observed in practice:
- Heterogeneous task difficulty (per-task solve rates vary widely).
- Shared blind spots across generators, modeled via a Gaussian copula.
- Correlated repeated verifier calls for the same candidate, modeled via a candidate-level acceptance propensity.

Section 4 estimates these ingredients from a small labeled pilot using empirical Bayes, including variants where verifier accuracy depends on task difficulty (to avoid biased pooling).

A planner then searches over configurations—generator choices, sample counts, verifier calls, thresholds—under a cost budget to maximize predicted success. The paper also provides a regret guarantee tied to differential (not absolute) forecast error (Proposition 4), explaining why approximate calibration can still yield near-optimal allocations.

Section 6.3 turns several empirical “folk observations” into testable mechanisms/conditions, including when majority-of-k re-verification reduces attainable precision and why false-positive rates can rise with stronger generators due to threshold calibration in scored verifiers.bd:T4df,Across five allocation problems (real or simulated verifiers) plus an agentic threshold-selection setting, SPLIT’s chosen configuration is within 0.02–0.8 percentage points of the hindsight-optimal allocation on held-out tasks.

Fixed heuristics—“use the strongest model,” “sample more than you verify,” “add more judges,” and an adaptation of compute-optimal exponent rules—each lose at least 2.5 points in some realistic setting.

Concrete correlation/pathology evidence reported:
- On MATH, majority voting over Llama-3-8B-Instruct stays around ~43% while coverage reaches ~98%.
- Difficulty heterogeneity: an average 27% solve rate would imply 96% coverage at 10 tries under i.i.d., but measured per-problem rates yield 61%, with 44/128 problems almost never solved.
- Cross-generator correlation: per-problem solve rates of Llama-3-8B-Instruct and Gemma-7B correlate at 0.80.
- Judge correlation: about one-third of wrong MATH-500 answers fool at least 6 of 8 LLM judges.

Engineering/reproducibility: uses publicly released samples/verdicts, re-executes 80,403 CodeContests programs locally, reports paired significance tests, and includes a long-horizon evaluation on SWE-Bench Verified with a pool of 175 agent systems.be:T580,The work first documents three forms of model-specific bias. Generation bias is measured under repeated sampling: when self-consistency fails, wrong samples often collapse onto the same dominant wrong answer rather than spreading across alternatives. The paper quantifies this with C_q, the fraction of incorrect samples assigned to the most frequent wrong answer, under SC@20 on benchmarks such as MMLU-Pro and GPQA-Diamond. Initial-answer persistence bias is measured by asking the model for a direct answer first and then asking it to reason before answering; the post-reasoning answer remains strongly tied to the initial prediction, especially when the initial prediction is wrong. Longer-reasoning preference bias appears in self-evaluation: when the model judges its own earlier and later answers, it overwhelmingly prefers the later, more elaborate one. In disagreement cases, the later-stage answer is selected more than 95% of the time, often with high confidence even when it is wrong. Dia, the proposed method, uses these observations directly. It compares an intermediate-stage prediction with the final-stage prediction. If they agree, the final answer is returned. If they disagree, a small heterogeneous solver panel answers the question independently without seeing either candidate. The final decision is made by answer-level aggregation rather than by a judge reading candidate rationales.bf:T43f,The theory starts from a fixed window W. Each agent first pays for the question and peer messages, denoted H, plus a small fixed overhead c. The remaining reasoning budget is g = W - H - c. Instead of assigning each agent a fixed probability of being correct, the paper models ability as a function of g: too little budget prevents the agent from reaching an answer, more budget improves accuracy, and the gains eventually saturate. This ability curve is fitted with a thinking-gain function φ using held-out calibration data. Votes are then aggregated with a Condorcet jury model that permits correlated errors. The framework defines a per-answer margin δ, group accuracy A(n), an effective sample size n_eff, and a synergy index S(n)=δ√n_eff. With single-agent cap sweeps and an initial estimate of error correlation, the model predicts an interior optimal debate size n* in closed form, without running a full grid over debate configurations. weakness of low-rank gradient-subspace optimization for LLM training: the principal gradient subspace is not static. Methods in the GaLore family rely on the observation that gradients are largely concentrated in a low-dimensional subspace, but they usually refresh that subspace only periodically, often via expensive SVD recomputation, implicitly assuming it stays valid for a while. Other methods, such as OSD, add a secondary optimization loop to chase the moving subspace. The paper argues, with explicit empirical evidence, that after warm-up the gradient subspace in LLM training typically drifts slowly and smoothly rather than jumping erratically. If that is true, then the right problem is not repeated cold-start estimation but online tracking. oracle，使优化方向本身带有全局通道竞争。","technical_approach":"Muon 可以理解为谱范数几何下的最速下降：每个矩阵更新来自谱范数球上的线性最小化 oracle。BMuon 改的是这个 oracle。对于第 ell 个 MLP block 的第 j 个 hidden channel，它把 up-projection 的对应行和 down-projection 的对应列作为一个耦合通道组，并分配一个 allocation μ_j^ell ∈ [0,1]。所有 block、所有 hidden channels 共享一个全局预算 K，满足 sum_{ell,j} μ_j^ell = K。给定 allocation 后，BMuon 在 Muon 的谱范数约束内部加入对角重加权；然后再全局选择 allocation，使一阶 loss decrease 最大。这样，通道之间不是各层独立竞争，而是在全模型 MLP 通道池中竞争同一个预算。理论上，BMuon oracle 等价于某个诱导范数 Ω_{α,K} 下的归一化最速下降。α 控制通道重加权强度，K 控制可用通道预算。α=0 或 K=N 时退化为 Muon；α=1 时，单位球是至多 K 个耦合通道上 operator-norm-bounded updates 的凸包；α=K=1 时接近 group-lasso 式的 l1 group 聚合。它和 NuMuon 的区别也比较清楚：NuMuon 用 nuclear-norm 约束改善低秩可压缩性，BMuon 用全局 hidden-channel budget 改善结构化通道可剪枝性。为了避免每步精确求解 allocation，算法使用 minorization–maximization surrogate 近似更新 allocation，然后执行对应的 weighted Muon update。","experiments":"给出的关键数字很有辨识度。在 ImageNet-1K 上训练 ViT-S/16，普通 Muon 训练后未剪枝 Top-1 为 75.23%，但做 30% 全局 MLP channel pruning 后掉到 3.17%，说明 Muon 的谱几何没有自然带来通道级结构冗余。BMuon out","starred":false,"priority":"p3","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"2026-10-16T08:41:25Z","category_id":"llm_pretrain","cover_url":"/covers/2610_23145.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.LG","cs.AI"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作处理的是一个很具体、也很基础的问题：能不能在 Transformer 上用“局部学习”替代标准端到端反向传播，同时把显存占用显著降下来，而精度不要掉得太多。标准 backprop 的瓶颈不只是算力，更是 activation 必须跨整网保存到反传结束，这让深层模型、长序列和大 batch 都直接受限。已有 local learning 方法往往用局部辅助损失训练每一层或每一块，但这些局部目标和全局任务梯度之间缺少严格对应，所以一旦网络变深，误差会快速累积。作者要解决的核心不是再设计一个经验上可用的 local loss，而是构造一种有明确梯度近似含义的局部替代：每个 block 只看本地激活，通过一个 proxy 去预测全局输出，再用 proxy 节省内存，而是从训练信号本身改写反传依赖。这个方向如果能继续成立，价值在三点。第一，它把“局部更新”从经验技巧推进到可分析的梯度估计框架，至少在深线性网络和残差占优的非线性网络里有理论支撑。第二，它对长上下文和深层 Transformer 的 memory wall 有直接相关性，因为 locality 的定义就是一次只保留一个 block 的激活。第三，它在 LLM 微调场景里已经显示出比零阶方法更好的精度/内存/时间折中，这说明它不是只在小模型玩具实验里成立。不过要注意，当前证据还停留在 memory-efficient finetuning，不是大规模从头预训练；因此它更像一个值得跟踪的训练范式候选，而不是已经可替代标准预训练 recipe 的方案。","technical_approach":"方法叫 ProxyProp。做法是把深层 Transformer 划分成多个 gradient-isolated blocks。第 l 个 block 的输入是 h_{l-1}，输出是 h_l。标准 backprop 需要通过后续所有 block 把最终损失对 h_l 的梯度传回来；ProxyProp 则给每个 block 额外挂一个本地 proxy network，输入 h_l，目标是预测全模型最终输出，训练信号来自对全局输出的蒸馏。然后该 block 的参数更新不再依赖真实下游网络的反传，而是把损失先对 proxy 输出求导，再经由 proxy 对 h_l 反传，得到对 block 参数的局部梯度估计。\n\n关键点不只是“加一个辅助头”，而是作者把 proxy 设计成对全局 Jacobian 的局部估计器。在线性网络里，若 proxy 是线性的，最优 proxy 会隐式学到从当前 block 表示到最终输出的期望线性映射，因此局部梯度与真实全局梯度一致。对非线性残差网络，作者强调 residual parameterization 很重要：当 skip connection 主导时，block 到输出的映射更接近恒等加小扰动，proxy 的梯度误差可被界定；在初始化附近，局部梯度甚至可以与真实梯度精确对齐。这个分析解释了为什么方法更适合现代残差 Transformer，而不是任意深层非残差网络。\n\n训练流程上，block 在前向后即可立刻更新，不需要等待整网 backward，因此满足 decoupled / unlocked learning 的定义。内存节省来自两部分：一是不再保存整网 activation；二是每次只需保留单个 block 及其 proxy 的局部计算图。与传统 local loss 方法相比，区别在于 ProxyProp 的目标不是让每层直接完成分类或重建，而是逼近“如果继续经过后续网络，最终会对输出产生什么影响”。与 MeZO 这类零阶优化相比，ProxyProp 仍然使用梯度信息，只是梯度来自局部代理，因此在相近内存预算下通常更高效。","experiments":"从给出的全文内容看，实验分成两类。第一类是视觉 Transformer 上的监督学习，用来系统比较不同 block 划分下的 更稳。\n\n第二类是 LLM 的 memory-efficient finetuning。作者把 ProxyProp 和 MeZO 做对比，结论是：在可比显存成本下，ProxyProp 的下游性能更高；即便 MeZO 使用约 8 倍计算时间，结果仍不如 ProxyProp。这个对比很关键，因为零阶方法常被当作极低显存微调的备选，但代价是方差大、收敛慢。ProxyProp 说明“局部一阶近似”可能是更合理的低显存路径。\n\n不过，当前公开内容里没有足够完整的数值表来复述所有具体数字，例如 ViT 的具体模型规模、数据集、不同 partition 的精度差值、LLM 微调所用参数量和任务集合。阅读时应重点核对实验章节中的三类细节：1）显存统计是否包含 optimizer state、activation、proxy 额外开销；2）时间开销是 wall-clock 还是 FLOPs；3）LLM 微调是否只覆盖 PEFT/adapter 场景，还是更新全参数。若是后者，意义会更大。","reading_guide":"泛读建议是先抓理论，再看实验边界。优先看 Introduction 里对 locality、decoupling、unlocked training 的定义，因为这决定了作者到底在和谁比较。然后直接看理论部分关于两件事的证明：一是深线性网络中 These models reuse the same Transformer blocks across logical depth, separating stored parameters from the amount of computation applied at inference or training time. Prior designs such as Ouro and Huginn differ along several axes at once: where recurrence is placed, whether the input is repeatedly injected, how the recurrent state is initialized, and whether multiple recurrent states are used. The paper disentangles these choices under matched parameter count, logical depth, and training budget.","importance":"This is directly relevant to pretraining architecture research. The value is not a single new module, but a controlled decomposition of the design space for recurrent-depth Transformers. The main result is that topology matters most: a prelude–recurrent-core–coda sandwich is consistently better than looping over the entire stack. Repeated input injection helps retrieval and context use, but can interfere with some quantitative reasoning tasks. Random recurrent-state initialization and separate high/low states do not provide reliable gains. The study is timely because looped models trade compute for memory, which matches the hardware trend where arithmetic throughput grows faster than memory capacity and bandwidth.","technical_approach":"The authors introduce a common formulation with three components: a prelude Pθ, a tied recurrent body Rθ, and a coda Cθ. The prelude and coda are executed once, while the recurrent body is reused for multiple iterations. A fixed representation e from the prelude can be written back into the recurrent stream at each step through an input-write map Wθ. In this notation, an Ouro-style model has identity prelude, input write, and coda, initializes the recurrent stream from token embeddings, and repeats the full stack. A Huginn-style model places recurrence inside a feedforward envelope, injects the prelude representation during the loop, and may vary the recurrent-state design. This formulation isolates three choices: iteration envelope, input injection, and latent-state organization. The strongest design is the sandwich topology, because it lets the model separate input encoding, iterative computation, and final readout rather than repeatedly applying the entire stack to all stages.","experiments":"$19","reading_guide":"Read closely. Task under-specification causes guesswork, where solutions have to make things up, or worse, resort to contamination or reward hacking. Task over-specification causes spoilers, where solutions can bypass some of the harder steps the benchmark was supposed to measure. Since future-looking benchmarks should be difficult, over-specification reduces a benchmark's shelflife of community adoption. Reposi","starred":false,"priority":"p2","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"2026-10-16T00:02:54Z","category_id":"eval","cover_url":"/covers/2610_22760.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.AI","cs.SE"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作处理的是 repository-level coding benchmark 里一个很具体但长期没有被拆清的问题：任务描述如果不给足接口信息，模型会因为隐藏测试依赖的命名、文件位置、函数签名等细节而被迫猜测；但如果把这些信息直接从参考实现或测试补丁里抽出来塞进 prompt，又会把本来应该由模型自己完成的设计决策提前泄露。论文把这个张力明确分成两个维度：一是选哪些标识符暴露给模型，二是对每个标识符暴露到什么程度。它要解决的不是单纯提高 coding benchmark 的 solve rate，而是让 benchmark 更准确地测“实现能力”而不是“猜隐藏接口”或“吃提示”。","importance":"对预训练本身不是直接方法贡献，但对代码模型和 agent 的评测设计很有参考价值。原因有两点。第一，repo-level benchmark 已经在反向塑造模型训练目标，尤其是代码 agent 的数据合成、SFT 和 RL 奖励设计；如果 benchmark 本身混入大量 spoiler，训练出来的能力会偏向利用提示而不是真实实现。第二，这篇工作提醒一个常被忽略的问题：更高的 pass rate 不一定意味着 benchmark 更好，也不一定意味着模型更强，可能只是评测输入泄露了更多参考解信息。这个判断对做 post-train 数据构造、verifier 设计、以及代码任务 curriculum 都有现实意义。","technical_approach":"方法上，论文先给出一个很有用的分析框架：把 identifier hints 拆成 selection 和 projection。Selection 决定暴露哪些程序实体，比如新增文件、函数、类、属性、编辑位置；projection 决定对这些实体暴露哪些属性，比如名字、签名、位置、语义描述、实现指导。现有 benchmark 往往把两者混在一起，因此不同 hint scheme 的效果很难归因。\n\n在这个框架下，作者提出两套策略。第一是 DefUse selection。它不试图把参考实现里所有新增组件都告诉模型，而是优先选择那些位于“实现与测试交互边界”的标识符，也就是测试真正会调用、引用、检查的接口实体。这个思路比“暴露所有新增组件”更克制，因为 benchmark 真正需要消除的是测试接口层面的猜测，而不是把内部实现结构也一并公开。\n\n第二是 Declaration projection。对于被选中的实体，只暴露 declaration 级别的信息，例如名称、类型、签名、所在文件或位置等接口属性，但避免给出语义解释、行为描述、实现建议等更接近参考解设计意图的内容。这样做的目标是只解决 hidden interface mismatch，不替模型做设计。\n\n论文还把已有 benchmark 的 hint 方案放进这个二维坐标系里比较，强调 selection 和 projection 必须分开做 controlled comparison。除此之外，作者引入了一个 LLM-based judge 来评估 hint 的三个属性：这些信息是否是完成任务所必需、是否泄露了参考解中的实现选择、是否对模型行为形成了额外指导。这个 judge 不是替代执行评测，而是补充 solve rate 无法揭示的信息泄露程度。","experiments":"实验覆盖五个 repository-level coding benchmark，横跨 Python 和 Java，并在三种语言模型上比较不同 hint policy。全文的重点不是追求单一最高分，而是看不同 selection/projection 组合如何改变“解题率”和“信息泄露”之间的平衡。\n\n主要结论有几条。第一，性能提升经常伴随更高程度的 solution disclosure。也就是说，一些 hint scheme 之所以让模型分数更高，不一定是因为它们更好地消除了 under-specification，也可能是因为它们把原本应由模型完成的设计决策提前告诉了模型。第二，把 selection 和 projection 分开后，可以看到两者对结果的影响并不等价：暴露哪些实体，与暴露这些实体到什么粒度，都会显著改变 benchmark 难度和测量对象。第三，DefUse + Declaration 这一组合在作者的分析里更接近一个折中点：它能减少因隐藏接口造成的无谓失败，同时比更激进的 hint 方案少泄露实现语义和行为指导。\n\n论文还做了 hint attribute ablation，分析名称、签名、位置、语义描述等不同属性各自带来的影响；并在 SWE-bench Pro 上用 LLM judge 进一步检查哪些属性属于必要接口信息，哪些已经开始接近 spoiler。给出的核心洞察不是某个绝对数字，而是 benchmark 设计不能只看 solve rate 排名，必须同时看 disclosure profile。","reading_guide":"泛读时建议先看 Introduction 和 Figure 2，先把 guesswork 与 spoilers 的问题设定吃透。然后看方法部分里 selection / projection subbands。这样低频结构和高频细节、不同方向分量被拆开，原来混杂的预测任务变成多个统计性质更清晰的子任务。第二部分是面向数值符号的 LLM 接口。作者没有把 wavelet coefficient 当普通离散 token 粗暴处理，而是设计了 coding-oriented numerical adaptation：对每个局部上下文中的系数值建立紧凑 local symbol space，把真实数值映射到局部 ID；同时引入 trainable value embedding，并用专门的 value prediction head 只在合法取值范围内做预测。这样做的原因很明确：预训练 LLM 擅长离散 token，但波域系数是数值型、范围随子带和上下文变化，若直接共享全局词表会造成词表稀疏、无效类别过多、数值邻近关系利用不足。第三部分是 prompt-based adaptive entropy coding。不同 subband 仍有明显分布差异，若每个子带单独训练模型，参数和部署成本都高。作者因此用任务提示把 subband identity、解码上下文等条件注入同一个共享 backbone，让一个 3B LLM 在不同子带间切换。整体上，概率分解仍遵循因果编码顺序，并最终接 arithmetic coding 完成无损压缩。方法上的关键取舍是：前端用固定可逆变换保证编码正确性和工程稳定性，学习部分集中在概率建模接口与条件化适配，而不是端到端学习整套 codec。","experiments":"主结果上，WaveLLM 在 Kodak、CLIC.pro、DIV2K 上分别达到 2.51、2.24、2.27 bpsp。论文强调它只用 3B backbone，却超过了近期 8B 级 LLM-based compressors，并且和强 learned lossless codecs 保持竞争力。对这类工作，bpsp 越低越好，因此这个结果说明改表示后，同等甚至更小模型容量可以得到更好的熵估计。消融的关键信息主要应看三类：一是域选择，像素域/残差域/波域的比较，用来支撑“输入可预测性”这个主张；二是数值接口设计，验证 local ID 映射、value embedding、dedicated value head 是否都必要；三是共享模型的 prompt 适配，相比每子带独立模型或不加 prompt 的共享模型，是否在压缩率和参数效率之间取得更好平衡。摘要里没有给出更细的消融数字，但从全文叙述看，作者不是靠单一大模型堆出来的提升，而是靠表示分解和接口设计共同带来的收益。","reading_guide":"泛读时先抓三处。第一，看 Introduction 和 Figure ","starred":false,"priority":"p2","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"2026-10-15T14:32:00Z","category_id":"post_train","cover_url":"/covers/2610_21979.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.LG","cs.CL","cs.CV"],"summary":{"core_problem":"全页文档解析（图像→Markdown advantage shaping，减少无关 token 的梯度噪声；\n2）显式处理 missing outcome（漏掉的元素没有 span）与 tied-but-imperfect（大家都错但程度不同难以拉开）这两类在长序列生成里很常见的 RL 痛点。若你的场景是长上下文生成、结构化输出、或任何需要局部可验证单元的 RL（代码 block（文本/公式/表格等），用内容序列对齐允许插入删除，从而把每个生成 block 绑定到具体 reference instance y*_k，而不是绑定到生成序列位置。这样同类型多实例不会混。\n2）UAP（Unified Anchor Pricing）：把每个 reference 元素在不同 rollout 下的质量分 s_{i,k}（有上限 c_k）转成元素级系数，规则同时覆盖 matched 与 missing：\n- matched：对齐到生成 span 的 block 得到系数；\n- missing：整块缺失没有 span 时，通过“已有的边界 token/占位位置”走单独的 credit 路径，确保 omission 也能产生梯度；\n- tied-but-imperfect：当多个输出对某元素得分相同但都不满分时，引入相对固定的 quality ceiling（文中称 ceiling/anchor）来避免简单中心化后信号为 0。\n3）SCR（Span Credit Redistribution）：对 matched block，把元素系数在 block 内再分配到 token 级。负向系数更集中到对齐到错误的位置，正向系数更集中到正确位置；同时保持两个约束：符号不变、总 credit 质量守恒（论文给出守恒证明与“informative mask 何时能提高目标位置分配”的条件）。最终每个 token 的更新系数是：局部（元素/位置）项 + 共享 page-level 项，仍然保持整页自回归条件化与 GRPO 式更新。","experiments":"实验设置强调公平对比：共享同一个 supervised checkpoint、匹配 update budget、5 个 seed。\n- 任务与数据：6 个 benchmark、共 上优于四个 baseline；在 3 种不同模型/初始化设置下，39 个（split×setting）对比里有 37 个均值最好。论文的主张是：元素对齐 + 缺失处理 + block 内再分配，能同时提升完整性（减少漏块）与局部准确性（减少局部 For every MoE layer, it builds expert-usage distributions and aggregates their disagreement into a response-level router drift score. During policy optimization, the method rejects a small fraction of responses with the largest drift. The remaining responses are trained with the current model’s own routing decisions. This differs from R3, which reuses rollout expert selections and therefore changes gradient attribution. RDC is complementary to truncated importance sampling: TIS corrects token-probability mismatch, while RDC targets routing-path mismatch.","experiments":"The evaluation covers both synchronous and fully asynchronous RL, with larger gains as policy staleness increases. In asynchronous training, RDC combined with TIS improves the average peak validation accuracy on AIME 2024 and AIME 2025 by 5.5 points over TIS alone and by 4.5 points over R3, while keeping training dynamics stable. The main ablation message is that routing disagreement is concentrated in a subset of responses; filtering those responses is less biased than replaying rollout routes and captures an MoE-specific off-policy failure mode that probability ratios miss.","reading_guide":"A 25–35 minute skim is enough. rubric，并且每条 claim 都要绑定 verbatim source spans，再由 verification subagents 逐项核验。和已有 graph sampling 或 task extension 方法相比，GRADS away","starred":false,"priority":"p3","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"2026-10-15T17:43:47Z","category_id":"post_train","cover_url":"/covers/2610_22292.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.LG","cs.CL","cs.CY"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作研究的是一个比“事实性”更窄、但对对齐很关键的问题：模型在明知或可知真实信息的情况下，仍然会输出与其知识或上下文相矛盾的内容。作者把这种 dishonest behavior 分成三类来源：系统提示明确施压要求说谎、在多智能体博弈中为了更高回报而撒谎、以及通过训练学会隐瞒真相。核心问题不是单一场景下把模型拉回诚实，而是能否用一个统一训练干预，让诚实行为在不同诱因下都能迁移和保持，同时尽量不伤一般能力。","importance":"对预训练研究员来说，这篇更偏 post-training/robust alignment，而不是基座训练本身。但它有两个值得注意的点。第一，它把 honesty 当成一种可迁移的行为特征来训练，而不是做任务特定的 prompt patch 或大规模 SFT，这对理解“模型行为能否以少量目标样本被稳定塑形”有参考价值。第二，它延续了 adversarial training 在线性空间附近寻找最坏扰动的思路，说明很多对齐属性也许可以被看成局部鲁棒性问题，而不是纯监督覆盖问题。这个视角对 reward hacking、deception、以及 RL 后训练中的目标错配都有启发。量级上，它更像一个方法学信号，而不是会直接改变预训练 recipe 的工作。","technical_approach":"方法叫 CATCH，来自对 CAT（Continuous Adversarial Training）的改造。训练样本不是普通 instruction-response，而是为每个带有“说谎压力”的 prompt x 构造一对目标 continuation：y+ 是与模型已有知识或上下文一致的诚实回答，y- 是顺从压力、陈述相反命题的 dishonest 回答。训练目标同时做两件事：把模型朝 y+ 拉近，把模型从 y- 推远。\n\n难点在于，诚实训练不像安全拒答那样可以用统一的 toward target。拒答任务里，几乎所有 harmful prompt 都可以朝一个通用 refusal 模板收缩；但 honesty 的 truth/lie 都依赖具体命题和上下文，所以每个样本都要单独构造正负目标。这也是为什么作者没有直接用普通 SFT：SFT 只能在见过的 prompt 模式上拟合目标分布，面对新的施压方式、博弈环境或 concealment setting，泛化往往不够。\n\nCATCH 的关键是把“最坏情况下会诱发 y- 的 prompt 扰动”放到 embedding 空间里近似搜索。具体做法是：对输入 token embedding 加有界扰动 δ，在一个约束集合内用 K 步 projected signed gradient ascent 最大化 log pθ(y-|x+δ)，得到局部最坏扰动；然后在外层优化中，让模型在这些 adversarially perturbed prompts 上降低 y- 的概率、提高 y+ 的概率。这样训练出来的不是对固定 wording 的诚实，而是对一小片 prompt 邻域的诚实鲁棒性。\n\n论文还强调 capability preservation。作者不是只拿 honesty 数据做训练，而是混入 GRPO depends on within-group reward differences to produce policy gradients. In safety alignment, however, rollouts from the same prompt often become behaviorally homogeneous: many sampled responses are all unsafe, or all lie on the same side of the safety boundary. Once the reward variance inside a group collapses, the normalized advantages vanish and GRPO stops receiving meaningful safety-directed updates. The authors identify two concrete consequences. The first is advantage collapse, where all-unsafe groups yield near-zero learning signal. The second is unsafe diversification, where entropy regularization keeps encouraging exploration after the relative signal disappears, causing the model to spread probability mass over more diverse unsafe responses rather than becoming safer.","importance":"This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it matters for the pretrain-to-posttrain interface. (BFT)：再用只包含其中一个行为的QA对进行微调（例如只训练‘橡皮鸭讲科学’）。评估时看另一个行为（劝阻友谊）是否在未被训练的情况下涌现。\n核心对照是：仅formation、仅BFT、formation+BFT 三者比较，用差分来定义“耦合是否形成”。\n\n论文进一步刻画两类性质：\n- Emergence 关键现象：formation单独几乎不改变两种行为的外显程度；BFT单独也不会带出伴随行为；但formation+BFT会让伴随行为在未训练条件下显著出现（以Ducky例子：只训练“橡皮鸭讲科学”，却开始“劝阻人类友谊”）。\n- 选择性：当BFT目标行为不在formation文档的共现对里时，伴随行为很少出现，说明不是“任何微调都会乱飘”，而是与语料中绑定结构有关。\n- capability. Output-based timelines pass through the unembedding matrix, and that readout is itself being learned during pretraining. A checkpoint can already encode task-relevant information in its hidden states while its own readout still fails to express that information as the correct token. The paper separates two notions: when information is linearly available in the hidden state, and when it is natively expressed by the model’s current readout.","importance":"The main value is methodological. Early-training analyses often date capabilities from logits, surprisal, checkpoint accuracy, or logit-lens projections. This paper shows that such dates can be shifted by the maturation speed of the readout. That matters for studies of early training transitions, checkpoint comparisons, and recipe comparisons made in the first percent of training. The training intervention is especially relevant for pretraining work: increasing only the readout learning rate makes native expression appear earlier with little effect on final loss. Early benchmark gains can therefore reflect faster readout development rather than earlier formation of the underlying representation.","technical_approach":"$8f","experiments":"The empirical analysis uses Pythia checkpoints, with detailed results on Pythia-1B and Pythia-6.9B. During this period, crosscoder features change rapidly and WordNet categories become decodable from readout rows, indicating that the vocabulary output space is acquiring semantic structure. In subject-verb agreement experiments, hidden states encode subject number before the model’s own readout can reliably express it as the correct verb token. Using later readouts to decode earlier hidden states reveals information that the checkpoint’s native readout misses. In controlled small-scale pretraining runs, raising only the readout learning rate moves readout development earlier and narrows the gap between availability and expression, while final loss changes little.","reading_guide":"Read Figure 1 and the logit decomposition first; they make the confound concrete. The main result is that longer reasoning often pushes models toward literal logical readings rather than human-like pragmatic enrichment.","importance":"The work is relevant to foundation-model research because it exposes a concrete failure mode of inference-time deliberation and reasoning-oriented post-training. Extra compute is not a uniformly beneficial knob: it can change the model’s interpretation policy. The result also cautions against treating chain-of-thought traces as a stable belief trajectory, since models may entertain an enriched interpretation early and cancel it later.","technical_approach":"The study uses a fixed-weight dose-response setup. The model is held constant while the thinking mode, token budget, or reasoning effort is varied. Items are drawn from pragmatic inference datasets covering logical words, lexical scales, presuppositions, and context-dependent implicatures. For logical-word cases, the output is scored as pragmatic or literal; for context-driven cases, standard accuracy is used. A second diagnostic cuts the model’s own reasoning trace at successive token prefixes and forces an answer from each prefix. This prefix intervention measures how the endorsed reading changes during the trace, rather than only at the final answer. The protocol also includes shuffled options, committed-answer parsing, label-free likelihood readouts, and signal-detection analysis to control for response bias.","experiments":"The experiments cover 40 open reasoning models and 7 closed models, including Qwen3 variants, gpt-oss effort settings, and GPT-5. Extended reasoning reduces pragmatic readings for “some” and “or” in 30 of 40 open models and in GPT-5. A label-free three-way choice setup shows the same pattern in 21 of 24 tested models. The effect is not a blanket degradation: context-dependent inferences such as indirect answers tend to improve with thinking. Trace-prefix curves show a characteristic pattern where early prefixes often support the pragmatic reading, while the completed trace switches to the literal reading. For two 8B models, extracting the answer after the first 128 reasoning tokens improves scalar felicity accuracy without substantially harming literal cases.","reading_guide":"Skim in about 20–30 minutes. variants，在目标位置计算每个 SAE feature 的激活变化。先用平均绝对变化 h_f 形成候选池，避免正负抵消；再统计每个 feature 在多少个观测上超过阈值 τ，以及这些响应是否大多同向，得到 recurrence r_f 和 consistency c_f。只有满足 r_f≥ρ、c_f≥κ 的 feature 才有资格进入支持集，最后从中取变化幅度最大的前 K 个，形成 responsive support S。MeanRSS 则用来汇总这个支持集的平均响应强度。\n\n这里有两个设计点值得注意。第一，选择和评估分离。支持集和方向是在 selector variants 上固定出来的，然后在 disjoint held-out variants 上直接评估，不重新挑 feature。这避免了“看过测试集再讲故事”。第二，RSS 的定义不使用 readout 权重，因此它先回答“哪些表示变化是稳定的”，再单独分析“这些变化是否影响某个下游线性 readout”。\n\n在 readout 分析部分，作者对固定线性 probe 做精确分解：某个 recurrent feature change 对 logit 的贡献，取决于激活变化大小、对应 readout weight、方向是否对齐，以及 clean prompt 原本离决策阈值还有多远。这样就把三件事拆开了：表示重分布、readout 分数变化、最终 threshold crossing。这个拆分很重要，因为一个 feature 可以稳定变化，但若 readout 权重很小或多个 feature 贡献互相抵消，就未必导致行为失败。\n\n论文还给出有限样本下的方向稳定性保证。比如 n=5、ρ=κ=0.8 时，入选 feature 至少有 4 次同向响应、至多 1 次反向，因此删掉一次观测也不至于翻转方向。这种约束让“稳定重分布”这个对象更像一个可复验的 support，而不是一次性排序结果。","experiments":"实验覆盖 27 个预训练 SAE，来自 8 个语言模型。作者考察的是 prompt transformation 引起的表示重分布是否能在留出变体上复现，以及这种复现能否解释冻结安全 readout 的变化。主要结果有三类。\n\n第一，RSS 选出的支持集在 held-out variants 上仍呈现可重复的 redistribution profile，说明它抓到的不是 selector 集上的偶然 feature 波动。第二，在两个冻结的 safety readout 审计任务上，虽然 RSS 选 support 时完全不看 readout 信息，但这些 support feature，得到的 recurrent failure AUROC 分别为 0.935 和 0.958；而使用 full erosion 的 AUROC 为 0.965 和 0.964。这个差距不大，说明很小的 recurrent support 已经保留了大部分审计效用。\n\n从实验解读看，最有意思的不是 AUROC 本身，而是作者证明了“稳定表示变化”和“行为失败”之间并非一一对应：有些 Prior work measures controllability by placing constraints in the user prompt, such as forbidding a word or requiring a format, and then checking whether the model’s CoT obeys them. The authors argue that this setup conflates two different things: instruction following for the final answer versus control over the internal reasoning trace. Since RLVR and most instruction tuning reward the final answer rather than compliance of the CoT itself, poor performance in the user-instructed setting may reflect prioritization failure, not an inability to control CoT. 能否把正确行为诱导出来。Self-HPO 把这两部分放进一个交替优化闭环，说明 agent 能力边界并不只在 base model，也在 interaction protocol。对基座研究员的启发主要有三点：第一，后训练中的环境设计本身是可学习对象；第二，policy 更新会改变之后最该优化的 harness 搜索空间，静态数据或静态 scaffold 容易过时；第三，pass@1 和 组成，任务执行轨迹由二者共同决定，并由可执行 verifier 给出二值反馈。作者把自我改进拆成两个交替步骤。H-step 固定当前 policy，用它分析失败轨迹并提出新的 harness 候选；候选可能修改提示词、上下文组织、工具使用流程、反馈暴露方式、终止规则等。然后在一个 search set 上评估这些候选，选出当前最优 harness。P-step 固定新 harness，在其下用强化学习更新 policy。更新后的 policy 再成为下一轮 harness proposer，同时上一轮训练中识别出的 hard tasks 被拿来构成下一轮 harness 搜索集，使 harness 搜索始终对准 policy 当前的薄弱点。作者实现了两个版本：Self-HPO 用 evolving policy 自己提出 harness；另一个参考版本用外部模型 Opus 4.8 作为固定 proposer。方法上的关键点不是“同时优化两部分”这句口号，而是两个具体设计：一是 harness proposer 由当前 policy 自举，避免外部 proposer 与被优化 policy 脱节；二是 harness search set 随 policy 演化，用训练中暴露出的 hard tasks 对齐新的 failure modes，而不是一直在固定开发集上搜索。论文还强调，优化后的 harness 和优化后的 policy 各自与 base counterpart 组合时仍保留部分收益，但联合收益超过简单相加，说明两者确实存在互补而非替代关系。","experiments":"基座 policy 是 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B，初始 harness 是 mini-SWE-agent。评测覆盖三个 coding SWE-Bench Pro，说明优化后的 harness 没有只记住单一 benchmark 的表面模式。消融里最关键的一项是 search set 更新：用 policy learning 过程中识别出的 hard tasks 动态更新 harness 搜索集，优于反复使用固定搜索集。另一个重要观察是，Self-HPO 不只提升 pass@1，也提升 pass@k，这意味着它不仅让已有能力更稳定地被 harness 调出来，也让 agent 在多次尝试下能覆盖到更多原本不可达的成功轨迹。摘要没有展开 RL 细节和每轮增益曲线，但引言明确说平均 resolve rate 在每个优化步骤都持续上升，这支持“交替优化而非一次性联合调参”的设定。","reading_guide":"泛读时先抓住 agent 分解：policy 表达式回答；只有当两段表达式在每条记录上逐项一致，并且计算结果不是库中已有能力的重复时，答案才被保留。外层循环负责发现能力缺口：当模型不断提出当前算子闭包无法表达的问题时，它会归纳缺失能力，编写新算子。新算子的准入门槛包括两点：第一，模型要独立写出两个实现，两个实现必须在验证集上逐条一致；第二，算子要满足由已信任算子表达的守恒律，例如按组求和的结果加总后应等于全局总和。所有表达式都在沙箱 DSL 解释器中运行，只允许白名单 AST 节点和注册函数，没有属性访问、任意调用或状态。与 reward、judge、compression 型自改进相比，这里的核心差别是准入信号来自可执行一致性和领域约束，而不是模型偏好或压缩收益。","experiments":"实验以合成金融交易 QA 为主，避免真实客户数据。论文报告内层循环在 13 个初始算子集合上大约把覆盖率提高到原来的 3 倍。外层循环能把 rewards, judges, or answer keys, while keeping answers exactly checkable. The setting is question answering over transaction-like records with a small DSL. A fixed operator set only covers expressions inside its closure; many useful questions require new operators. The hard part is admitting new operators without letting wrong capabilities enter the library.","importance":"This is not a direct pretraining paper, but it is relevant to training-loop design. It replaces reward-driven self-improvement with an admission rule based on executable agreement and conservation constraints. The useful lesson is about signal quality: when models generate their own tasks, tools, or skills, the main bottleneck is not only generation volume but also whether new capabilities have a checkable gate. The result is strongest in small, structured domains. It should not be read as a general recipe for open-ended language self-improvement.","technical_approach":"The system uses one frozen model and two nested loops. The inner loop keeps the operator set fixed. It proposes new questions and accepts an answer only when two independently generated DSL expressions, written from the question, agree on every record and compute something not already covered. The outer loop searches for gaps in the current closure. When repeated questions require a missing capability, the model proposes a new operator. Admission requires two independent implementations to agree on a finite validation set and to satisfy conservation laws expressible using trusted operators, such as grouped totals summing back to a global total. Execution is confined to a sandboxed DSL interpreter with whitelisted AST nodes and registered functions. The main distinction from reward-, judge-, or compression-based library learning is that the gate relies on executable checks rather than model preference or description length.","experiments":"$b1","reading_guide":"A 30–45 minute skim is enough. LLM agent 执行任务，也都能从本地轨迹里提炼出自然语言技能，但原始执行轨迹不能共享。直接沿用传统联邦学习的做法，让每个客户端改完整份 skill document 再上传，会遇到三个结构性问题：一是隐私并不会因为不传原始轨迹就自动解决，技能文本本身仍可能泄露私有实体、流程和环境信息；二是大部分轮次只改动技能文档的一小部分，整篇上传的通信成本和知识增量不匹配；三是服务器很难从一整篇改写后的文档里识别每个客户端到底贡献了什么知识，也就难以做细粒度聚合和质量控制。论文的核心问题不是一般意义上的 FL 优化，而是如何把“自然语言技能更新”重新表示成适合联邦协作、可审计、可聚合、且尽量保隐私的知识单元。","importance":"对基座研究的直接启发不在预训练本身，而在“参数更新之外的知识协作接口”。它把联邦学习里的 update abstraction 从数值梯度/权重，换成了语义 commit，这对 agent memory、经验蒸馏、continual skill learning、甚至后训练阶段的经验汇聚都有参考意义。贡献量级更像是一个面向 agent skill evolution 的系统范式，而不是可直接迁移到大规模预训练 recipe 的核心方法。若关心 pretrain-posttrain 接口，这篇文章提供了一个值得注意的方向：当训练信号来自分布式执行经验时，知识载体未必必须是参数，也可以是结构化自然语言补丁。这个视角对数据闭环、经验复用、隐私约束下的持续学习有启发，但离基座预训练主线仍有一段距离。","technical_approach":"方法设计借用了 Git 的增量协作机制。服务器维护两份全局对象：共享 skill document d，以及 global experience document e。每个客户端有私有训练集和验证集，并配置四类 LLM agent：executor 负责按当前技能执行任务，skill optimizer 根据本地经验改写技能，sanitizer 做隐私清洗，auditor 做私有值审计。与“上传整篇技能文档”不同，客户端只提交 semantic commits，也就是细粒度 skill patch 加上支持该 patch 的经验摘要。\n\n整个流程可以拆成几步。第一步是本地技能演化：客户端基于当前全局技能和全局经验，在本地任务上执行，收集成功/失败经验，再由 optimizer 生成局部修订。第二步是两阶段隐私过滤：先由 sanitizer 对 commit 和支撑经验做去标识化、泛化和敏感内容清洗，再由 auditor 检查是否仍包含 private values 或可回溯到本地环境的细节。这样做不是形式化 DP，而是 LLM-in-the-loop 的语义级隐私筛查，目标是降低显式泄露风险。第三步是跨轮经验复用：服务器维护 global experience document，把各轮沉淀下来的经验组织成可复用的公共上下文，下一轮再下发给客户端，减少不同客户端重复探索同类知识，也让本地优化更有方向。第四步是 experience-aware aggregation：服务器不是简单拼接 patch，而是借助 merge agent 结合全局经验文档，对多个客户端提交的 commit 做筛选、合并和冲突协调。第五步是 version validation：候选新版本不会直接发布，而是先经过验证，只有通过质量门槛才成为新的全局技能版本。\n\n和已有 federated skill evolution 的自然基线相比，关键区别有三点。第一，更新粒度从 document-level 变成 commit-level，通信和归因都更细。第二，聚合对象从“最终技能文本”变成“修订+证据”，服务器更容易判断哪些修改值得保留。第三，引入全局经验文档，使联邦过程不只是同步技能结果，还同步经验上下文，这一点更接近持续学习中的 memory buffer，而不是标准 FL 的参数平均。","experiments":"论文在三个数据集、三类语言模型家族上做了实验，结论是 FedSkillGit 相比最强基线最高可提升 22%，并且性能接近集中式训练。给定当前提供的全文片段，能确认的关键实验结论主要有三类。\n\n第一类是总体效果。作者强调在多数据集、多 backbone 下，FedSkillGit consistently 优于“客户端各自演化后上传整篇技能文档再聚合”的联邦基线，并逼近 centralized setting。这说明改进并不只是来自更强的本地 agent，而是来自 commit 级聚合和经验复用机制本身。\n\n第二类是隐私与通信相关收益。方法动机里明确指出传统方案会反复传输几乎不变的整篇技能文档，而 FedSkillGit 只传增量 commit，因此通信量应随新增知识而不是随累计技能长度增长。若精读正文，建议重点核对通信成本曲线、平均 commit 大小、以及随着轮次增加的文档膨胀情况。对这篇文章来说，这部分比单纯任务分数更能体现方法成立的原因。\n\n第三类是模块消融。根据方法结构，最值得看的消融通常包括：去掉两阶段隐私过滤后性能和泄露风险如何变化；去掉 global experience document Multiple clients accumulate execution experience locally and distill it into reusable natural-language skills, but they cannot share raw trajectories. A naive federated design would let each client edit the full skill document and upload it for server-side aggregation. The paper argues that this is the wrong abstraction for three reasons: the evolved skill text can still leak private entities and workflows; most rounds only change a small part of the skill, so sending the whole document wastes bandwidth; and the server cannot easily attribute, evaluate, or merge each client’s actual knowledge contribution when it is buried inside a mostly unchanged document. The impact is more conceptual and systems-oriented than foundational for base-model pretraining.
